THE CORE IDEA

runs.text: At a world price, domestic consumption is read from demand and domestic production is read from supply. When domestic consumption exceeds domestic production, imports fill the difference; when production exceeds consumption, the excess is exported. The comparison must be made at the world price because that price guides both domestic buyers and sellers under free trade.
